speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: We are concerned about underwater noise and vibrations caused by construction and operation of the wind park.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: This may affect communication, navigation and feeding of marine mammals and fish.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Without mitigation, the project may lead to habitat displacement and negatively impact SDG 14.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has an obligation to prevent, reduce and control pollution under Article 194 UNCLOS.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: If underwater noise qualifies as pollution, Arcadia must use the best practicable means at its disposal.
